expected_dialogue: Last spring this empty lot collected weeds and rainwater. Neighbors decided it could feed families instead. Over three weekends volunteers built raised beds. Then they planted tomatoes herbs and peppers. Now the Saturday market supplies fresh produce to dozens of local families.
